query: As of July 2026, financial and bankruptcy status of these companies: Chegg Inc, America's Car-Mart Inc, JetBlue Airways, Peloton Inc, Faraday Future Intelligent Electric, Petco Health and Wellness. Which are at highest risk of bankruptcy filing in mid-2026? Any going concern warnings, debt maturities, or restructuring news?
answer:
Research complete. Summary of findings:

**Highest bankruptcy risk in mid-2026 — two clear candidates with explicit going-concern warnings and September 2026 deadlines:**

1. **America's Car-Mart (CRMT)** — Explicit going-concern warning; FY2026 net loss of $139.2M; covenant defaults with a Term Loan waiver expiring **Sept 7, 2026**; strategic review underway; closed ~40% of dealerships; only $47M cash against $722M debt and no revolving credit facility.

2. **Faraday Future (FFAI)** — Explicit going-concern warning; management said it "will likely seek bankruptcy protection unless it can secure new funding"; only ~$12M cash; near-zero revenue ($0.5M Q1); Nasdaq delisting deadline **Sept 16, 2026** with stock at ~$0.13.

**Moderate risk (less imminent):**
3. **Chegg (CHGG)** — Revenue collapsing 48% YoY from AI disruption, but net-cash-positive; small $33.9M convertible maturity (Sept 2026) is covered by $68M cash. No going-concern warning.
4. **JetBlue (JBLU)** — CCC+ credit rating, sustained losses, analysts flag ~75% Chapter 11 odds by 2027 — but $2.2B liquidity and no major maturities until 2029 make mid-2026 filing unlikely.

**Low risk (de-risked):**
5. **Petco (WOOF)** — Just refinanced (Feb 2026), maturities pushed to 2031, $654M liquidity, back near breakeven.
6. **Peloton (PTON)** — Turnaround succeeding; expects first-ever full-year net income in FY2026; net debt down 70% to $173M; $1.1B cash.

The full report with all financials, debt structures, and sources is above, and structured data has been submitted.

key_facts: America's Car-Mart (CRMT) issued an explicit going-concern warning; FY2026 (ended Apr 30, 2026) net loss of $139.2M; credit losses ~40.8% of sales; closed 60 of 154 dealerships (~40%).

CRMT amended its Term Loan on June 19, 2026 for limited covenant relief (minimum liquidity, Collateral Coverage Ratio, reporting, and inability to deliver an unqualified audit opinion), with a Scheduled Termination Date of Sept 7, 2026 (extensions possible to Sept 21 / Nov 6, 2026); it also obtained short lender forbearance amid defaults.
CRMT total indebtedness $722.4M ($300M senior secured Term Loan + $458.7M non-recourse securitization notes); no revolving/warehouse credit facility; unrestricted cash only ~$47.0M.

Faraday Future (FFAI) issued a going-concern warning; management stated it 'will likely seek bankruptcy protection unless it can secure new funding'; only ~$12.2M cash and ~$76.0M negative working capital.

FFAI Q1 2026 revenue just $0.512M with a net loss of $42.3M; stock ~$0.13, down ~96% from 52-week high; Nasdaq delisting compliance deadline Sept 16, 2026 (immediate delisting risk if bid <=$0.10 for 10 days).
FFAI SEC ended its multi-year investigation in March 2026 with no enforcement action (removes an overhang but not the liquidity problem).
Chegg (CHGG) Q1 2026 revenue fell 48% YoY to $63.3M (Academic Services -57%) due to AI disruption; small net profit of $0.2M after ~60% opex cuts; no explicit going-concern warning.
Chegg has $33.9M of 0% convertible notes maturing Sept 1, 2026, being repurchased at discounts; cash/investments ~$67.9M — sufficient to retire remaining notes.
JetBlue (JBLU) downgraded by Fitch to CCC+ (from B-) on April 3, 2026, its third Big-Three downgrade in 18 months; Q1 2026 net loss $319M; FY2025 net loss ~$602M.

JetBlue has ~$755M debt due 2026, $411M in 2027, $516M in 2028, then no significant maturities until 2029; ~$2.2B liquidity plus ~$6.5B unencumbered assets; total debt ~$9B; some analysts cite ~75% bankruptcy probability by 2027.

Petco (WOOF) refinanced on Feb 2, 2026 ($900M new term loans + $600M senior secured notes), extending maturities to 2031; total debt reduced >$100M to ~$1.48B; ~$654.4M total liquidity; Q1 2026 net loss $15.1M driven by $11.8M debt-extinguishment charge; Adjusted EBITDA $97.3M.

Peloton (PTON) turnaround succeeding: Q1 2026 net income +$26.4M; expects first-ever full-year positive net income/operating income in FY2026; repaid remaining $199M of 2026 convertible notes; net debt down ~70% YoY to $173M; ~$1,126M cash; next maturities are $350M 5.50% converts due 2029.
